text:
zendesk-bot: Incoming ticket from Stark Industries — customer reports they were charged twice on annual renewal. Two paid invoices: INV-2026-00123 and INV-2026-00124. Customer PO 5567 was updated same day. Customer asks for immediate reversal and VAT clarification.

ana: ack, pulling invoices now. can you paste txn ids if available? :eyes:

zendesk-bot: customer pasted: txn_7a2b9c_INV123, txn_8c3d4e_INV124. payment methods: card ending 4242, and PO reference 5567.

ana: thanks. quick check — looks like both invoices were generated: one from auto-renew cron, one from PO webhook after PO was updated/approved this morning. suspect double-issue on webhook idempotency. paging billing.

mike: on it. can you paste the webhook delivery ids / timestamps from internal logs? i want to confirm a duplicate POST.

ana: grabbing logs: ```
2024-11-04T09:02:17Z payment-service INFO received webhook id=wh_aa11 payload={"po_id":5567,"action":"approve","order_id":"ORD-778"}
2024-11-04T09:02:18Z billing-service INFO create_invoice external_id=INV-2026-00123 id=inv_abc123 created_by=auto_renew
2024-11-04T09:02:19Z payment-service INFO received webhook id=wh_aa11 retry_count=1 payload={"po_id":5567,"action":"approve","order_id":"ORD-778"}
2024-11-04T09:02:20Z billing-service INFO create_invoice external_id=INV-2026-00124 id=inv_def456 created_by=webhook
```

jess: that log looks like the webhook got delivered twice with same id but no idempotency header checked by billing-service. we had a partial rollback in feb where idempotency was optional.

mike: yep. looks like billing-service didn't check X-Idempotency-Key because the header was missing from the retry. retry_count=1 produced a second invoice. both were paid quickly by card + PO settlement. initiating refund flow for duplicate. which invoice should we refund? keep older one, refund the later webhook-generated one?

ana: customer prefers refund of INV-2026-00124 (the webhook one). confirm VAT handling — they want net amount refunded if tax already remitted.

samir: tagging tax team separately, but for support path: we can refund gross and record VAT reversal in ledger. legal/tax may need invoice credit note. propose: refund INV-2026-00124, create credit note CN-2026-045 for VAT reporting, and mark PO as settled once.

mike: performing refund now. running internal refund command: ```
# run by billing operator
POST /internal/refunds 
{ "invoice_id": "INV-2026-00124", "reason": "duplicate_charge", "initiated_by": "mike" }
```

billing-bot: Refund initiated: RFD-98765 for invoice INV-2026-00124 — status: pending.

mike: quick sanity check: payments table shows two payment rows: 
```
id | invoice | txn_id            | amount | status
---+---------+-------------------+--------+--------
101| INV-2026-00123 | txn_7a2b9c_INV123 | 1200.00 | settled
102| INV-2026-00124 | txn_8c3d4e_INV124 | 1200.00 | settled
```

ana: thanks. I'll message customer that refund has been started and estimate 3-5 business days to reflect. please update once billing-bot shows succeeded and CN is created.

billing-bot: Refund update: RFD-98765 -> succeeded, amount 1200.00 USD, refunded to txn_8c3d4e_INV124 (card). Credit note created: CN-2026-045 (VAT 20% reversed).

ana: notifying customer: "Hi — we discovered a race where a PO approval webhook retried and created a duplicate invoice. We've refunded INV-2026-00124 (RFD-98765). A credit note CN-2026-045 was issued to reverse VAT. Refund should appear in 3-5 business days; let us know if you need documentation for your accounting."

zendesk-bot: Customer replied: "Thanks — can you also confirm the charge on card 4242 was reversed? Need proof for AP."

mike: we refunded to the card txn, bank confirmation id: bank_ref_44321. attaching refund receipt (pdf).

ana: closing the ticket once customer confirms receipt. internal follow-up: open bug to enforce idempotency header check in billing-service and add a migration to dedupe invoices created within 1 minute for same PO/order id. created issue #BI-4023.

jess: added postmortem note to incidents channel, tagging eng-runtime + eng-ml for visibility on retry behavior for webhooks. :white_check_mark:

ana: done — keeping ticket open until customer confirms. overall impact: single customer double-charge, amount 1200 USD, resolved within 2 hours.
